title: Automations
subtitle: Create tasks, update fields, assign owners or call webhooks when records change — or when they go quiet.
emptyHint: Create tasks, update fields or call webhooks when records change.

list.emptyHint: Start from a template — e.g. “Deal won → onboarding task” — or build your own.
list.name: Name
list.deleteConfirmBody: The automation and its run log are removed. Records it already changed stay as they are.
list.scheduleHint: Event triggers run instantly in the browser that makes the change (and in the CLI). Schedule and inactivity triggers are checked every 5 minutes while an admin tab is open, and by `agentcrm automations run --yes` from a cron or GitHub Action.

trigger.title: When

summary.inactivity_one: When a {{object}} has no activity for {{count}} day
summary.inactivity_other: When a {{object}} has no activity for {{count}} days

trigger.toHint: Leave empty for any new value.

conditions.title: Only if
conditions.hint: All conditions must match the record. Leave empty to run on every record.
conditions.none: No conditions — runs on every matching record.

actions.title: Then

summary.addNote: Add a note to the timeline

actions.valueHint: Empty clears the field. Text values accept placeholders.
actions.webhookHint: POSTs the record as JSON (raw and display values). Best effort: failures are logged, other actions still run.

test.title: Test on a record
test.hint: Checks the conditions on a record and shows what the actions would do (the trigger is ignored).
test.confirmReal: Run the actions on this record?
test.confirmRealBody: The actions are applied now and logged in the run log.
test.notMatchedHint: This record wouldn't trigger the automation.

runs.emptyHint: Runs appear here each time an automation fires.

templates.hint: Ready-made automations. “Use” creates it right away (enabled), “Customize” opens it in the editor first.

deal-won-onboarding.name: Deal won → onboarding task
deal-won-onboarding.description: When a deal reaches a won stage, create an onboarding task for its owner due in 2 days and log a note.

new-lead-round-robin.name: New lead → assign round robin
new-lead-round-robin.description: When a person is created as a lead, assign an owner in turn among active admins and members, and create a first-touch task.

stale-deal-followup.name: Deal stale 14 days → follow-up task
stale-deal-followup.description: Open deals without any activity for 14 days get a follow-up task for their owner (once per idle period).

deal-lost-note.name: Deal lost → log the reason
deal-lost-note.description: When a deal moves to a lost stage, log a note with the lost reason on its timeline.

customer-welcome.name: New customer → welcome task
customer-welcome.description: When a person's lifecycle stage becomes Customer, create a task to send the welcome pack.

new-person-webhook.name: New person → webhook
new-person-webhook.description: POST every new person as JSON to a URL you own (Zapier, Make, n8n, Slack workflow…). Set the URL before enabling.
